s.zh:
额外攻击（物理职业）：
第 1 档：战士、圣武士、武僧、野蛮人或游侠 5 级（游荡者没有，改用偷袭） — 近战冷却 ×0.80，追击 15%，射击冷却 ×0.85
第 2 档：战士 10 级 — 近战冷却 ×0.70，追击 25%，射击冷却 ×0.75
第 3 档：战士 15 级 — 近战冷却 ×0.60，追击 35%，射击冷却 ×0.65

只有武僧的人只在徒手时生效。
追击：普通近战命中后再按原版近战结算打一下（Isekai 力量、武器品质照常）；追击不再触发追击。
s.en:
Extra Attack (martial classes):
Tier 1: fighter, paladin, monk, barbarian or ranger level 5 (rogues don't get it and use Sneak Attack instead): melee cooldown ×0.80, follow-up 15%, shooting cooldown ×0.85
Tier 2: fighter level 10: melee cooldown ×0.70, follow-up 25%, shooting cooldown ×0.75
Tier 3: fighter level 15: melee cooldown ×0.60, follow-up 35%, shooting cooldown ×0.65

For people who are only monks, it only applies unarmed.
Follow-up: after a normal melee hit, strike once more using vanilla melee resolution (Isekai Strength and weapon quality apply as usual); follow-ups don't trigger further follow-ups.

s.zh:
切换精准射击的模式：
要害：伤害 ×(1.5 + 0.5 × 射术强度)，穿甲 +30%。
打腿：伤害 ×0.7，目标移动 ×0.5 持续 10 秒。
打手：伤害 ×0.5，有机会打落武器：成功率 = 50% + 10% ×（自己的敏捷调整值 + 熟练加值 − 目标的力量调整值 − 熟练加值）+ 20% ×（射术强度 − 1），限 15%～90%，体型 2 以上减半。
s.en:
Switch precise shot mode:
Vital spot: damage ×(1.5 + 0.5 × marksmanship power), armor penetration +30%.
Leg shot: damage ×0.7, target movement ×0.5 for 10 seconds.
Hand shot: damage ×0.5, with a chance to knock the weapon away: success chance = 50% + 10% × (own Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus − target's Strength modifier − proficiency bonus) + 20% × (marksmanship power − 1), limited to 15%-90%, halved against body size 2 or more.
